name: onchikitsa
description: OnChikitsa monorepo: backend + landing + admin + 2 mobile apps

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix admin install && npm --prefix OnChikitsa_user install && npm --prefix OnChikitsa_clinic install
scripts.mobile:user: npm run sync-env && npm --prefix OnChikitsa_user run mobile
scripts.mobile:clinic: npm run sync-env && npm --prefix OnChikitsa_clinic run mobile
scripts.mobile:all: npm run mobile:user && npm run mobile:clinic
scripts.web: npm run sync-env && concurrently -n backend,frontend,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run backend" "npm run frontend" "npm run admin"
scripts.server: npm run sync-env && concurrently -n backend,frontend,admin,mobile -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm run backend" "npm run frontend" "npm run admin" "npm run mobile:all"
